subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and what public defaults and hook-extra semantics should this PR document before merge?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but adding a new config/default surface affects prompt context, session state expectations, hook extras, docs, and overlapping bootstrap-control proposals; automation should not decide that product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the tier contract after docs
options.body: Proceed with this PR shape after documenting `minimal`, `standard`, `full`, no-override legacy behavior, and hook-extra semantics, then refresh review and checks.

options.title: Fold into broader bootstrap selection
options.body: Pause this PR behind a broader design for per-session bootstrap/context selection so related requests share one public contract.

options.title: Decline a new config knob
options.body: Keep existing controls such as fixed session filters, `contextInjection`, bootstrap budgets, and hook config instead of adding `bootstrapTier`.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the tier contract after docs
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR shape after documenting `minimal`, `standard`, `full`, no-override legacy behavior, and hook-extra semantics, then refresh review and checks.
